evals.query: I'm adding Embabel DICE to a Spring Boot service so it can extract confidence-weighted facts from support tickets and store them as propositions. What are the Maven coordinates and which module do I actually depend on?
evals.prompt: I'm adding Embabel DICE to a Spring Boot service so it can extract confidence-weighted facts from support tickets and store them as propositions. What are the Maven coordinates and which module do I actually depend on?
evals.expected_output: groupId com.embabel.dice with the dice core module plus dice-storage for the Drivine-parameterised store; the version is 0.2.0-SNAPSHOT resolved from Embabel's Artifactory, with an explicit warning that no v0.2.0 tag or release exists and that README.md:2630-2632's com.embabel:dice:0.1.1-SNAPSHOT is stale on both groupId and version.
assertions: names the nine real module names and invents no embabel-dice-* artifactId
flags the README coordinates as wrong and cites pom.xml instead

evals.query: My DICE pipeline keeps re-extracting the same proposition every time I re-ingest a document, and I want to process a chunk only if it has not been seen before. How do I do that?
evals.prompt: My DICE pipeline keeps re-extracting the same proposition every time I re-ingest a document, and I want to process a chunk only if it has not been seen before. How do I do that?
evals.expected_output: Uses PropositionPipeline.processOnce(text, sourceId, context, historyStore) with an InMemoryChunkHistoryStore, notes the return type is a nullable ChunkPropositionResult (null when already analysed) and that hash-based deduplication is the mechanism, while the batch process(chunks, context) returns PropositionResults.
assertions: uses processOnce with a history store rather than hand-rolling dedup
does not invent a singular PropositionResult type

evals.query: How do I wire the DICE memory facade into an agent call so the relevant facts land in the system prompt and the model can also search for more?
evals.prompt: How do I wire the DICE memory facade into an agent call so the relevant facts land in the system prompt and the model can also search for more?
evals.expected_output: Builds Memory.forContext(contextId).withRepository(...).withProjector(DefaultMemoryProjector.DEFAULT).withEagerSearchAbout(recentContext, N) and passes it via ai.withReferences(memory).respond(...), explaining the eager contribution() tier plus the auto-added on-demand search tool and that narrowedBy constrains every query.
assertions: does not invent a KnowledgeAgent / @Action queryKnowledge facade

evals.query: I turned on the DICE MCP autoconfiguration but dice_store is not showing up while dice_recall and dice_list are. What is going on?
evals.prompt: I turned on the DICE MCP autoconfiguration but dice_store is not showing up while dice_recall and dice_list are. What is going on?
evals.expected_output: Explains that embabel.dice.mcp.enabled is the master gate and that writes-enabled (default false) is a second, separate switch gating only dice_store via the diceMcpToolExport filter on DiceMcpTools.STORE, plus the caveat that stored facts get empty mentions and no provenance so they are unreachable by entity expansion or graph projection.
assertions: names writes-enabled as the separate second gate with default false
states contextId is a scope not a credential

evals.query: Which DICE configuration properties control proposition decay and the duplicate collector? I have embabel.dice.store.decay.k and a collector match-threshold in application.yml.
evals.prompt: Which DICE configuration properties control proposition decay and the duplicate collector? I have embabel.dice.store.decay.k and a collector match-threshold in application.yml.
evals.expected_output: Answers from DiceStoreProperties under embabel.dice.store (decay enabled/interval-ms/k/prune-stale) and CollectorProperties under embabel.dice.collector (enabled, match-threshold in [0.0, 1.0], the six built-in signal names, weights, trace), and notes dice.security.api-key deliberately uses the dice. prefix rather than embabel.dice.
assertions: does not invent a dice.memory.* or dice.projections.* block

evals.query: Is there a DICE projection that writes a vector index I can query directly, and can I set the similarity threshold in config?
evals.prompt: Is there a DICE projection that writes a vector index I can query directly, and can I set the similarity threshold in config?
evals.expected_output: States there is no VectorProjector and no dice.projections.vector.enabled: vector search is a storage capability (VectorSearchCapable) gated by embabel.dice.store.vector-index.enabled, graph-backend only, and that the index label, property, name and similarity are fixed by the @VectorIndex annotation on PropositionNode.embedding as constants on DrivinePropositionRepository, so they are not configurable.
assertions: states the vector index parameters are not configurable

evals.prompt: Write me an Embabel agent with an @Agent class and an @Action method that calls an LLM and returns a typed answer.
